description: This file is a JavaScript source file that defines the core functionality of the jsTree plugin, a jQuery-based tree widget. It includes plugin registration, instance creation, node manipulation methods, event handling, theming, and configuration defaults.

classes.name: $.jstree.core
classes.description: Constructor function for jsTree core instances, handling initialization, node operations, event triggering, and internal data management.
